listings.title: Doylestown Decorators Dream! Art, RH, Serena & Lily, Herman Miller, C& B, Pottery Barn + More
listings.description: **This private estate auction is PICK UP or THIRD PARTY SHIPPING only from an estate in Doylestown, PA*** SCROLL TO THE BOTTOM OF THIS PAGE FOR MORE DETAILS. Step inside an exceptional private estate filled with beautifully curated furnishings, original artwork, hand-knotted rugs, designer décor, outdoor pieces, collectibles, and more. This home was thoughtfully furnished with a mix of elevated contemporary design, timeless traditional pieces, original art, and distinctive vintage finds. Throughout the collection you’ll find sought-after names including **Pottery Barn, West Elm, Restoration Hardware, Serena & Lily, Crate & Barrel, Jill Rosenwald, Eddie Bauer, Longaberger, Frontgate, Ballard Designs, Arhaus**, and more. The art collection is a standout of this sale, featuring original and collectible works by artists including **Christopher Stott, Gray Malin, Christy Kinard, Jody Paul, Staci Swider, and Miles Talbott**, alongside vintage artwork and other unique pieces collected over time. Also included is an impressive selection of antique and modern hand-knotted rugs, many of which appear to have seen little or no use, as well as designer furniture, decorative accessories, faux botanicals and planters, outdoor furnishings, seasonal and Christmas décor, vintage collectibles, and distinctive pieces for nearly every room of the home. This is the kind of estate where every room offers something worth discovering—from recognizable designer staples to unexpected one-of-a-kind finds. Whether you’re furnishing a home, adding to a collection, sourcing for a design project, or simply looking for something special, this auction offers an extraordinary opportunity to purchase pieces from a beautifully appointed private residence. Please note that this property has been used as a secondary residence and the owners do have a cat. As a result, some items may show dust and overall signs of use. Overall, the collection has been very well maintained and most pieces are in very good to excellent condition, with any notable flaws or exceptions identified in the individual lot descriptions whenever observed. **Bidding is now open.** We will be adding more items until you do not see this statement anymore. Browse the full catalog, save your favorites, and don’t miss closing night. With a collection this extensive, there is much more to discover than we could ever fit into one description. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ PICK UP OR THIRD PARTY SHIPPING ONLY > KEEP READING! Pick up is Saturday October 3rd 1:00 pm - 6:00 pm. There will be NO OTHER pick up times. This is a private residence and we will not have access to the home after Saturday October 3rd. If you can't make pick up and need to send someone in your place, please send us an email. We will not respond to requests for alternative pick up dates/times. Bring your invoice, ID, proper moving help and an adequate vehicle. Please be respectful of staff and parking signs to help us make pick up a smooth process. Third Party Shipping Only. Third party shipper will be required to pick up from the location. We do not drop items off. UPS Store Buckingham, PA - Email only with lot numbers: store3831@theupsstore.com Philadelphia Mail Room - Email only with lot numbers: phillymailroom@gmail.com You may choose any third party shipper you would like, but if it is someone other than the two on our list, they will be required to pick up on October 3rd during regular pick up time and we will require an email from you to goldentreeteamllc@gmail.com confirming the shipping company with your name, invoice and a release form. **Presented by GoldenTree.**
